More Info Contact Us Hydrafacial Hydrafacial - Get the Best Skin of Your Life Daily exposure to environmental stressors like sunlight creates free radicals that damage skin cells, leading to aging and deterioration. Free radicals disrupt the skin's chemical balance and impair proper function. Antioxidants are the natural defense, neutralizing these harmful molecules and protecting the skin. Found in vitamins A and E, and plant extracts like white tea and rosemary, antioxidants are crucial for healthy skin. The HydraFacial is vital as it removes surface damage (dead skin cells, impurities) and uniquely replenishes the skin with potent antioxidants via its Vortex-Fusion technology, providing advanced nourishment and protection against free radical damage. Award-Winning Medical Spa – 2026 Top 10 Award Winner Botox in Plano, TX — Botox Treatments Ageing is just another word for living—but wrinkles don't have to define you. Refresh your look with Botox®, trusted injectable treatments that use botulinum toxin type A to gently relax facial muscles. Smooth away frown lines, crow's feet, and forehead wrinkles with a quick, non-surgical treatment performed by a licensed medical professional. Botox® is an FDA-approved type A botulinum toxin trusted for reducing frown lines between the brows and smoothing forehead wrinkles. In addition to its cosmetic benefits, Botox® also has medical approvals and can be used for conditions such as eye spasms and cervical dystonia. Administered by licensed medical professionals, Botox® offers a safe, non-surgical option to refresh your appearance and maintain a youthful, natural look. Botox – Benefits and Functions Smooth wrinkles appearing between the eyebrows, around the eyes, on the forehead, or around the mouth. Blocks nerve signals to facial muscles, causing relaxation and preventing further wrinkling. Short treatment time, fast recovery, and visible results shortly after the procedure. Reduced risk of allergic reactions due to minimal additives. Both treatments offer safe, non-surgical options to refresh your appearance and maintain a youthful, natural look. What to Expect at Wei Mei Med Spa A Botox treatment at Wei Mei Med Spa begins with a personal consultation to understand your goals and map the treatment areas. The injection process typically takes under 10 minutes, with no anesthesia required. Our injectors follow a "less is more" approach — starting conservatively so results look natural, never frozen. Most patients return to daily activities immediately after treatment. Full results develop over 7 to 14 days and typically last 3 to 5 months. Regular maintenance appointments help sustain and even enhance results over time. As a certified Botox provider in Plano, TX, our team brings both clinical precision and an artistic eye to every treatment. Frequently Asked Questions about Botox 🔆 How does Botox work? Botox® works by blocking nerve signals to facial muscles, causing them to relax and smoothing out wrinkles. It is an FDA-approved type A botulinum toxin used to reduce frown lines, forehead wrinkles, and crow's feet. 🔆 What to Expect During a Botox Treatment? The treatment is quick, with the injection process often taking less than 10 minutes. Your healthcare provider may numb the area first, though you may still feel the needle. The number of injections depends on the size of the area being treated. Our providers follow a “less is more” approach, starting with a small amount to avoid over-injection and ensure natural results. You can typically resume your day immediately after treatment. Full results may take up to two weeks to appear and generally last three to five months, depending on factors such as age, skin quality, and lifestyle. The key to a successful outcome is a thorough consultation and clear communication about your desired results. 🔆 What are the side effects of Botox? Side effects are generally rare and mild. The treatments work by relaxing facial muscles to smooth wrinkles between the eyebrows, around the eyes, on the forehead, or around the mouth. Typical side effects may include minor redness, swelling, or bruising at the injection site, but most patients experience quick recovery and can resume normal activities immediately. 🔆 How long do Botox results last? Most patients see results that last three to five months depending on age, skin condition, and lifestyle. Follow-up treatments help maintain results.
